item: Date fallback writes local digits instead of the browser's locale (open-on-main 16b)
summary: The last two bare toLocaleString() calls in src/static were the catch fallbacks of fmtDateTime and the task manager's fmtLocal, used when Intl refuses the language tag; they now write the local time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Re-confirmed on main 766a01339: the other nine of the eleven hits are comments, and the {action} failed: {error} template no longer exists.
